title: Eagle Screech
blurb: Hollywood attached this piercing cry to every bald eagle, and America attached it to everything else. Here is the twist: real bald eagles sound nothing like it. They make a thin, chirpy warble that test audiences found unimpressive, so films routinely dub in a red-tailed hawk instead. The legend stuck anyway, and the substitution is now more famous than the actual bird. Play it over flags and fireworks, over trucks and grills, and over anyone behaving aggressively American. Pairs beautifully with our Viking war horn for cross-cultural chaos.
origin: The iconic 'eagle' screech (usually a red-tailed hawk in reality), meme shorthand for America.
